policy.scope: Named Bible passages, not exact licensed Mass readings. Preserve original canonical appointments and explicit unavailable results.
policy.hebrew: Masoretic hbo OT retains source cantillation and niqqud. The NT uses the complete vocalized historical Delitzsch 12th edition (1901), transcribed at delitz.fr/12; all 260 source chapters are hash-pinned. Its source wording and vowel points replace the previous unpointed eBible heb transcription together; no niqqud is invented or transferred between transcriptions. Only U+05B0..U+05BC and U+05C7 on the four letters of יהוה are removed, retaining source cantillation and other marks. Edition-specific verse divisions and scan-verified transcription corrections are documented in delitzsch_numbering.py and delitzsch-source-reviews.json.
policy.arabic: Old Jesuit Arabic Bible, inspected 1897 Beirut printing. Sparse canonical transcription with page evidence; only exact concatenations of whole reviewed passage units may be displayed. Do not infer textual boundaries from numeric identity, slice reviewed units, or fill absent words from OCR or another edition.
policy.french: Whole chapters containing any empty verse are withheld: existing transcription has merged/shifted verse boundaries. Numeric validation alone is not proof of editorial accuracy.
policy.italian: NT and Pentateuch source inventory. 1 Peter 5 is incomplete upstream (only 11–14); entire chapter withheld.
policy.verseNumbers: Verse labels follow the selected Bible edition. Partial verses and larger mapping envelopes display enclosing whole verses with a notice. Daily source numbering requires agreement among supported systems or a bounded source review covering every calendar context. Reviewed NABRE appointments use the reference-only published marker inventory and STEP correspondences; the pinned DRA target maps directly from STEP Standard, while other editions use the explicit Standard-to-SIL-English bridge before reversible SIL mappings. The vocalized Delitzsch adapter preserves its published splits and accepts merged units only when their complete source text is requested. Other ambiguous or unreviewed mappings remain unavailable.
